query: Please implement a web application that supports WebSocket, allowing users to communicate with the server in real-time. The application should have functionalities for establishing connections, sending messages, receiving messages, and disconnecting. Users should be able to log in and interact with other users or the server in real-time, including sending text, images, and other types of messages. Use pearl for the background and charcoal for components.
